commands: PG_BIN=/usr/pgsql-18/bin; if [ ! -x "$PG_BIN/psql" ]; then PG_BIN=$(dirname "$(command -v psql)"); fi

"$PG_BIN/psql" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -U ecaz_coord -d postgres -At -c "SELECT relname FROM pg_class WHERE relname LIKE 'task107_phase1_rabitq_1m_l4%' ORDER BY relname;" > "$NODE_DIR/residue-before-cleanup.log"

"$PG_BIN/psql" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -U ecaz_coord -d postgres -c "DROP INDEX IF EXISTS task107_phase1_rabitq_1m_l4_idx; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS task107_phase1_rabitq_1m_l4_queries CASCADE; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS task107_phase1_rabitq_1m_l4_corpus CASCADE;" > "$NODE_DIR/cleanup-drop.log" 2>&1

"$PG_BIN/psql" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -U ecaz_coord -d postgres -At -c "SELECT relname FROM pg_class WHERE relname LIKE 'task107_phase1_rabitq_1m_l4%' ORDER BY relname;" > "$NODE_DIR/residue-after-cleanup.log"
